_about: Owner-editable. The plain reason behind each Rituals card: what is happening, why this answers it, and how it changes from day to day. No planet, book or method names. {theme} is the verse's own subject words.

Pitta.state_plain: On a hot, sharp day the body runs warm and short-tempered, and digestion burns fast.
Pitta.helps_plain: Cooling, mild foods calm that heat and keep the day even.
Pitta.adds_plain: Spicy, sour, fried or very salty foods add more heat to a day that already has plenty.

Vata.state_plain: On a dry, restless day the body runs cold and uneven, and digestion and sleep get erratic.
Vata.helps_plain: Warm, moist, grounding food settles digestion and the nerves.
Vata.adds_plain: Cold, dry or raw food, and skipped meals, add to the unevenness.

Kapha.state_plain: On a heavy day digestion and energy run slow, and the body holds on to what it eats.
Kapha.helps_plain: Light, warm, bitter or pungent food is easier to digest and keeps you moving.
Kapha.adds_plain: Sweets, oily or heavy meals and overeating add to the slowness.

Kapha/Vata.state_plain: Today swings between heavy and restless, so digestion is uneven.
Kapha/Vata.helps_plain: Warm, simple meals at regular times steady both ends of the swing.
Kapha/Vata.adds_plain: Cold, heavy or irregular meals feed the swing.

Vata/Pitta.state_plain: Today runs restless and a little hot, so appetite and mood can flare and drop.
Vata/Pitta.helps_plain: Regular mealtimes and mild, not spicy, food keep it level.
Vata/Pitta.adds_plain: Spice, caffeine and skipped meals add fuel to the restlessness.

Pitta/Vata.state_plain: Today runs hot and scattered at once.
Pitta/Vata.helps_plain: Cooling but grounding food, eaten calmly, settles both.
Pitta/Vata.adds_plain: Spice, cold raw food and eating in a rush add to the scatter.

food_strengthen_adds_plain: These pull against what today is feeding, so keep them small.
food_variation_plain: This follows the day, not a fixed list: the food guidance changes as the day's character changes, and the same day of the week brings it back around.
verse_variation_plain: The theme follows how your day reads, so it changes when the day turns. Within a theme the verse rotates, so you do not hear the same line two days running.
mantra_mechanism_plain: Slow, rhythmic repetition steadies your breathing and holds your attention on one thing. The benefit builds with regular practice, not from a single sitting.
mantra_variation_plain: It follows what needs support most in your chart that day, so it changes as that changes. Other chants, such as the Gayatri, are offered when they fit.

planet_area.Moon: your mood, rest and inner steadiness
planet_area.Mars: your drive, courage and how you handle conflict
planet_area.Jupiter: your judgement, guidance and good luck
planet_area.Rahu: your ambition and the restlessness that comes with it
planet_area.Ketu: your focus and your ability to let go

chants.name: Gayatri
chants.how_plain: Say it 11 times, slowly, at sunrise or before you start work.
chants.audio_credit_plain: Recording by Fadzil odd Huzairie, shared under CC BY-SA 2.5, via the Internet Archive.
chants.title: Recite the Gayatri mantra

chants.name: Hanuman Chalisa
chants.how_plain: Read or recite the forty verses once, steadily, on its day or when you need courage and steadiness.
chants.title: Recite the Hanuman Chalisa

chants.name: Vishnu Sahasranama
chants.how_plain: Recite or listen to the thousand names once, calmly, on a quiet morning.
chants.title: Recite the Vishnu Sahasranama

_about_chants: planets: the afflicted areas this chant is offered for (from the chart tables, editable). days: weekdays it is due (0=Mon). title: the remedy line shown. A chant is offered only when its planet is among the chart's active areas.
